faq.subtitle: We answer the most common questions about Revital
faq.notFound: Can't find the answer you're looking for?

wompi.question: What does the Wompi integration include?
wompi.answer: Our Wompi integration includes payment processing with credit/debit cards, PSE, Nequi and other popular methods in Colombia. Automatic webhook configuration, payment status handling and automatic reconciliation.

api.question: What does the AI assistant do?
api.answer: The admin panel AI assistant helps you see how your store is doing: it can give you sales summaries, show pending or recent orders, best-selling products and stock alerts. It can also help you create brands, categories and discounts from the chat, without hunting through every screen.

support.question: What kind of technical support do you offer?
support.answer: We offer email support on all plans, priority chat on the Professional plan, and priority support on the Enterprise plan. We also include complete documentation, video tutorials and monthly webinars.

customization.question: Can I customize my store design?
customization.answer: Yes, we include pre-designed templates and a basic visual editor to customize colors, logos and content. Ideal to start quickly with a professional design.

security.question: How do you handle security and compliance?
security.answer: We use SSL/TLS encryption, secure development practices (JWT, validation, isolated data per instance), and payment processing through Wompi's certified gateway. We follow privacy best practices and support GDPR compliance.
